code_contract_observation.writer: _zip_info() does not set flag_bits; stdlib zipfile emits 0x800 for non-ASCII names.
code_contract_observation.parser: _parse_deterministic_zip() rejects any central/local flags value other than zero.
code_contract_observation.contract_clause: CONTRACT.md §T2 requires deterministic stdlib ZIP, bounded UTF-8 text/code members, and refusal of encrypted/unsafe metadata; it does not ban valid UTF-8 filename encoding flag 0x800.
code_contract_observation.minimum_fix: Allow flags exactly 0 or 0x800 in both local and central headers; retain rejection of encryption, data descriptor, compression, ZIP64 and unknown flags; add Unicode create/verify/restore regression and the two refusal controls.
